packages.name: godot
packages.versionModel: upstream stable tag 4.7.2-stable (published 2026-08-18); assetRegex matches only Godot_v{version}-stable_win64.exe.zip
packages.discovery: github-release godotengine/godot, tag {version}-stable; the separate _console.exe.zip asset variants of older releases no longer exist, the console wrapper ships inside the same archive
packages.publisherCheck: GitHub release asset digest sha256:731980f9... is byte-identical to both an independent curl download and the updater's net.download during checkLayout

authenticode.subject: CN=Prehensile Tales B.V., O=Prehensile Tales B.V., L=Uitgeest, S=Noord Holland, C=NL
authenticode.peRule: verifyPEVersion: FileVersion 4.7.2 equals the manifest version and is enforced on every future update

commandModel.consoleWrapper: since 4.3 the Windows distribution embeds a small _console.exe forwarder next to the editor; both binaries print 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf for --version natively and through a Piko shim

stateModel.notOwned: editor settings and app_userdata live in %APPDATA%\Godot\; projects and their .godot directories stay wherever the user opens them
stateModel.exportTemplates: Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz (~1.2 GB) is a separate official asset and is intentionally not bundled

isolatedInstall.pikoHome: temporary directory with a local HTTP source copy
isolatedInstall.files: 2 payload files + install record; installed bytes identical to the archive entries (sha256 ab1824f8... / c8f0a6bc...)
isolatedInstall.uninstallReinstallCycle: payload fully removed (only an empty apps/godot directory remains); reinstall + use + shim pass

checks.updateCheck: anonymous GitHub API rate limiting (HTTP 403) marks the package blocked without false success, matching the documented bun behavior; discovery semantics were verified against the live releases/latest response (tag 4.7.2-stable, single matching asset, digest byte-identical)
checks.compactCheck: changedPackages 1 = pre-existing sunlogin drift (godot is already a byte-stable template document)
checks.hostEnvironmentNote: 19 update/auto-merge tests fail if `git` resolves to the host's piko shim without a default provider; with the managed git 2.56.0.4 directory prepended to PATH the full suite passes 146/146

packages.revisionReason: The original 4.7.2 platform item declared no desktop block, so an install produced no Start Menu or desktop launcher at all; the GUI editor was reachable only through the godot command shim.

desktop.rejectedTarget: Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe is PE Subsystem=3 (console); a shortcut to it opens a console window first
desktop.updaterRetargeting: nextManifest now rewrites the stripped upstream version (4.7.2) as well as the revision spelling, so a later 4.7.3 candidate does not inherit the 4.7.2 payload names

shortcutVerification.isolated: temporary PIKO_HOME with a local HTTP source copy
shortcutVerification.launched: process path is the GUI editor; window title is the Godot project manager; no console window
shortcutVerification.uninstall: the launcher is removed with its ownership receipt
shortcutVerification.hostRepair: the already-installed 4.7.2 receipt and state install record were backed up, given the identical desktop declaration, and regenerated through piko reset godot (client-written .lnk plus ownership hash); launching the repaired shortcut also reaches the project manager
